description: Draw real frames of the component as one filmstrip image, using the host page's markup and styles (elements with data-nudg names). Needs a local Chrome.

at.description: Frame times. Default: evenly spaced until at rest.

events.description: What happens, in time order. Each item is an event { "event": "track.tap", "t": 0.1 }, an input sample { "input": "track.drag.x", "value": 12, "t": 0.2 }, or a whole drag { "drag": "track", "t": 0.1, "until": 0.3, "dx": 20 } (down, dragstart, 60 samples per second, up, dragend).

dx.description: Horizontal travel of the drag, in logical units.

dy.description: Vertical travel of the drag, in logical units.

t.description: Seconds, or a string like "100ms". For a drag, when it starts.

file.description: Path to a .nudg.json file, relative to the working directory.

frames.description: Number of evenly spaced frames when `at` is not given. Default 6.

html.description: Page with the component's markup and styles. Its scripts don't run.

reducedMotion.description: Play as a reduced-motion user would see it: short linear tweens, no kicks (0.3).

start.description: Start in these states instead of initial, e.g. ["on"].

until.description: Last time to look at. Default: when everything has come to rest.

name: nudg_render
title: Render frames
